checks.detail: The original ascending loop fully rebuilds AP, AB and AT for a column before any entry is replaced. Its formulas read geometry, density and AP0, not old AP/AB. The descending cache therefore reads the current raw coefficients, including after changed timesteps or a repeated weather initialization.

Repository-wide AP/AB references are limited to allocation, declarations, TERMIP and PRIMP. No later caller needs the original AP/AB coefficients. All sixteen recurrence sites were replaced; the eight sweeps retain their existing traversal, pressure source terms, locks and back-substitution.

The cache stores the reciprocal in AP and the P coefficient in AB. AT remains unchanged and each Q update still evaluates (DIM + AT[kn] * Q[kn+1]) * TERMP. This is essential: reusing AT for the reciprocal would corrupt Q. The source-extracted checker confirms all sixteen Q expressions are unchanged.

AP, AB, AT, TERMP, PIM and pNext are double. The cache visits the same descending kn order and performs the same reciprocal and multiplication before storing each P value. It introduces no float narrowing, algebraic cancellation or rearrangement of the Q expression.

checks.topic: Upper boundary and initialized stack storage
checks.detail: The original first recurrence reads the untouched PIM slot above 2*(NK-1). The compiled baseline has exactly eight PRIMP lambdas, all with InitLocals=true. The extracted methods also checked that the top P/Q slots contain positive zero. This resolves the review concern about whether pNext=0 matches the actual baseline boundary. The separate SkipLocalsInit attribute on UVWIMP does not apply to PRIMP.

Cache columns match the pressure interior. Entries 1..2*(NK-1) are transformed; index 0 and the upper coefficient entries remain unchanged. NK=1 yields an empty transform. ICPN=false keeps the raw coefficients and adds no recurrence calculation; SIMPLE also bypasses CALCPR in that mode.

A TERMIP worker owns each complete i column. Its existing Parallel.For finishes before SIMPLE reaches CALCPR and PRIMP. The pressure sweeps only read the cached AP/AB values. No new array, task, reduction or shared writer is introduced.

evidence_review.test_scope: The direct harness extracts the sixteen recurrence blocks and actual guarded cache block. It does not replace full TERMIP execution; the complete fixed-order model tests exercise coefficient rebuilding and integration.

remaining_submission_gate: Measure repeatable whole-model benefit in the reserved native timing window; do not infer benefit from removed operations alone.
